messages.en: Linker combines site, roof and energy data in one project.
Linker provides the project workflow and editing tools. Your inputs and design are saved and recovered in the same project.
Map and 3D views use the project geometry. Source accuracy and permissions stay as recorded. The tool does not approve installations.
Interface and project data: React, TanStack Query and Ajv. 3D views: Three.js, React Three Fiber and Drei. Map display: MapLibre GL JS.
Street map: OpenFreeMap. © OpenMapTiles; © OpenStreetMap contributors.
